description: This file defines data structures related to session management, including session records, responses, and statistics, as well as functions for loading session data from a gateway service, primarily for a macOS application.

classes.name: GatewaySessionDefaultsRecord
classes.description: Represents default session settings including model and context tokens.

classes.name: GatewaySessionEntryRecord
classes.description: Represents a session entry with metadata such as key, display name, provider, timestamps, tokens, and model info.

classes.name: GatewaySessionsListResponse
classes.description: Response data structure for listing sessions, including defaults and a list of session entries.

classes.name: SessionTokenStats
classes.description: Stores token counts for a session, providing summaries and formatting for display.

classes.name: SessionRow
classes.description: Represents a UI-ready session with metadata, status flags, tokens, and age labeling.

classes.name: SessionKind
classes.description: Enumeration of session types with associated labels and colors.

classes.name: ModelChoice
classes.description: Represents a model selection option with provider and context window info.

classes.name: SessionStoreSnapshot
classes.description: Snapshot of current session store including path, defaults, and session rows.

methods.name: SessionLoader.loadSnapshot
methods.description: Asynchronously loads session snapshot data from a gateway, decoding response, and constructing session rows.

methods.name: SessionLoader.loadRows
methods.description: Convenience method to asynchronously load only the session rows from the snapshot.

methods.name: relativeAge
methods.description: Computes a human-readable age string for a given date.
